text:
Pavel Buchnevich is riding a four-game point streak (3 goals, 1 assist) as the Blues have turned into one of the league's loudest offenses, scoring 8 against Anaheim and 9 against New Jersey in the last week.

Through 23 games he has 6 goals and 11 points, and his finishing matches his chances almost exactly (6 goals on 5.84 expected). St. Louis outplays opponents slightly with him on the ice at 5-on-5, about 52% of shot attempts and expected goals. That's solid, and close to the 20-goal player he was last season.

What's missing is assists, 5 so far. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking gives him a real signature there: 19% of his setups come from behind the net, more than double a typical forward. Evolving-Hockey had him near replacement level last season, so his value this year depends on the playmaking coming back. Our range puts him at 35 to 54 points.
